subtasks.outcome: failed: knob reached but not turned; arm contorts onto it and leaves the workspace

behaviour_summary: Same as init0: pi0 approaches the knob with the gripper rotated sideways (100-180), the wrist comes down onto the knob at ~200, then the arm folds and swings left out of view (220-340) and stays out until timeout. Burner never turns on.
runs_trained_task: libero_10 KITCHEN_SCENE3 'turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it' (stove-knob approach; the instructed task is its first subtask)

failures.mode_definition: While approaching a small fixture (e.g. a knob), the arm folds into a twisted wrist/elbow configuration, contacts the fixture with the wrist body instead of the fingertips, then swings out of the workspace without completing the manipulation.
failures.rl_success_check: stove burner shows the on state (glowing) / knob rotated to the on position
failures.observation: At 140-180 the gripper hangs above/behind the knob with fingers vertical. At 200 the wrist body sits on the knob with the forearm folded; at 220 the gripper points sideways/up; at 240-320 the arm swings left over the stove and out of the frame. Knob at 409 looks the same as at 140; no lit burner.

notes: Onset only ±20 steps at 1 fps; reproduces task44_fail_init0 almost exactly, so the mode looks systematic for this knob in KITCHEN_SCENE9.
